headline: 4 Michigan deals, $16.4M raised — led by LIT Financial Corporation, Inc.

top_deals.summary: LIT Financial Corporation, Inc., a Troy-based financial services company, filed a $10M debt offering under Rule 506(b); $6M sold to 36 investors.
Brookstone Apts Holdings LLC, a Troy-based commercial real estate company, filed a $8.5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $8.5M sold to 63 investors.
Marlow Group LLC, a Traverse City-based lodging and conventions company, filed a $2M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.9M sold to 9 investors.
Atmosphere Clear Spirits LLC, an Ada-based company, filed a $1M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $0 sold.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $16.4M sold across 4 Form D filings this week. The largest was LIT Financial Corporation, Inc. (Troy, Other Banking and Financial Services) targeting $10M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Real Estate was the most active sector with 1 of 4 filings (25%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
Year to date, Michigan private issuers have reported $16.4M sold across 4 Form D offerings in 2025, with November the busiest month so far.
